ن: ن The twenty-fifth letter of the alphabet; called نُونٌ: it is one of the class termed ذَلْقِيَّةٌ [or liquids]; and is a letter of augmentation. === نّ with teshdeed, and preceded by a fat-hah, is sometimes redundantly affixed to a word at the end of a verse: see an ex. voce تَوٌّ. === ن, the sign of the dual, with damm, in one dial., instead of kesr, see خَشِيفٌ. === See also صَادٌ. === As a numeral, it denotes fifty.
